stimulus.source_note: Engraving of Bartolome de las Casas, 1791, public domain; Wikimedia Commons.
stimulus.text: This 18th-century engraving shows a Dominican friar writing at a desk, with books behind him and a quill in his hand. The caption below reads 'D. FR. BARTHOLOME DE LAS CASAS,' and calls him Bishop of Chiapa and 'defender of the Indians.'

parts.prompt: Identify the man pictured in the engraving.
Explain one reform Las Casas campaigned for.
Explain one limitation of this portrait as evidence about Las Casas.

instruction: Answer each part in your own words from the stimulus only. Do not open the question file.
